name: Toast with Cream Cheese, Honey-Crushed Raspberries & Pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Wash and dry raspberries; place in a medium bowl along with honey, cardamom, and cinnamon. Using a fork or potato masher, gently crush the raspberries until they reach a chunky, jam-like consistency. Set aside.
Arrange bread on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Spread cream cheese over the toast, then top with crushed raspberries and pistachios.
To serve, divide toasts between plates and enjoy!
author: Mealime
